info.name: Create and attach user to an organization

items.docs:
Create and attach a user to an organization. If the user already exists,
use the `attachUserToOrganizationV2` (`POST /v2/organizations/{organization_id}/users/attach`)
operation instead.

info.name: Attach an existing user to an organization

items.docs:
Attaches an existing user to an organization. You may provide the
`user_id` or `email`. If the user does not exist, you will need to use
the `createOrganizationUserV2` operation.

Removes the user from the organization. **NOTE**: This will remove the
user from __ALL__ of the companies within the organization.

info.name: Create and attach user to company

items.docs:
Create and attach a user to a company. If the user already exists, use
the `attachUserToCompanyV2` (`POST /v2/companies/{company_id}/users/attach`)
operation instead.

info.name: Attach an existing user to a company

items.docs:
Attaches an existing user to a company. You may provide the `user_id` or
`email`. If the user does not exist, you will need to use the
`createCompanyUserV2` operation.

Removes the user from the company. This does not remove them from the
organization, even when the user is not attached to any companies within
the organization.

info.name: List a user's roles in a company

items.docs:
Returns the list of roles currently assigned to a user within a specific
company. Roles are company-scoped and determine what actions the user can
perform within that company.

info.name: Update a user's roles in a company

items.docs:
Declaratively set the roles for a user within a company. The provided list
of roles replaces the user's current roles entirely — roles included in the
list become active, and all others become inactive.

This operation is idempotent: assigning roles that are already active has
no effect on those roles.

info.name: Set or clear a user's manager in a company

items.docs:
Set or clear the user's manager. Provide `manager_id` to set the
manager, or `null` to clear it. The manager must be a user within the
same company.

A user has a single manager that applies across every company they
belong to. The company in the path scopes who may call this and which
users are eligible to be the manager, but the resulting relationship is
not company-specific: setting or clearing it here changes the user's
manager everywhere they are a member, which can affect approval routing

items.docs:
List users accessible in the system. The users accessible will be those
that are attached to organizations that have granted access to your
client.

Update a user with the data provided. If fields are omitted, they will be considered `null` and will be cleared. If you do not wish to clear these values, please provide everything.

**Note**: A user's email is not allowed to be updated over the API. If a user's email must be changed, please use the Web UI or contact support about this.
